svg.title: Beryl: cryptography in pure Crystal, with no OpenSSL linked. Security for the Amber framework.
svg.desc: Beryl, the Amber crew's security member, in her gold-visored helmet beside her motorcycle on a rooftop at sunset, her black cat Mo on her shoulder. Beside her, Beryl's character mark and name, and a strip where a sweep passes over the message "hello, Amber" and leaves its SHA-256 digest, 8829a3a90ab30ebb..., behind it.
